# The focus leaving a ui.input commits an edit made since the last commit,
# through the mark Enter clears: once per edit, so Enter and then the focus
# leaving commits once, and a program's write or a test's change leaves
# nothing to commit. A test's focus() focuses the field as a click or Tab
# does, so the field it leaves loses its focus as a user's does. Only the
# targets whose test can move the focus: fyne's and bubbletea's are their
# packages' Go run tests (input_blur_commit_run_test.go), the interpreter has
# no focus to move, and gtk4's input still commits only at Enter. fyne,
# win32 and bubbletea committed only at Enter.

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   4 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   4 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=win32 --language=c app.sngl
stdout 'ok   4 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component main ui.node {
    var text = ""
    var away = ""
    var changes = 0
    var order = ""

    ui.vbox {
        ui.input #field(
            :value = text,
            @change(v) {
                changes += 1
                order = order + "c"
            },
            @submit {
                order = order + "s"
            },
        )
        ui.input #other(:value=away)
        ui.button #set(text="set", @click { text = "abc" })
    }
}

func testEditThenBlurCommitsOnce(t Test, c main) {
    c.field.focus()
    c.field.input("xy")
    t.assert(c.changes == 0)
    c.other.focus()
    t.assert(c.changes == 1)
    t.assert(c.text == "xy")
    c.field.focus()
    c.other.focus()
    t.assert(c.changes == 1)
}

func testEnterThenBlurCommitsOnce(t Test, c main) {
    c.field.focus()
    c.field.input("xy")
    c.field.submit()
    c.other.focus()
    t.assert(c.order == "cs")
}

func testProgramWriteThenBlurCommitsNothing(t Test, c main) {
    c.field.focus()
    c.set.click()
    c.field.focus()
    c.other.focus()
    t.assert(c.text == "abc")
    t.assert(c.changes == 0)
}

func testChangeThenBlurCommitsOnce(t Test, c main) {
    c.field.focus()
    c.field.input("xy")
    c.field.change("xy")
    c.other.focus()
    t.assert(c.changes == 1)
}

ui.window {
    main
}
